# Stealth

A wearer-side toggle for clothing that grants stealth. `WFStealthToggleComponent` on the item gives its wearer the
`WFActionToggleStealth` action, which switches the granted `StealthComponent` on and off; the item remembers the
setting across re-equips. While it is off the wearer carries `WFStealthSuppressedComponent`, which the stealth system
checks so a revival from crit or death doesn't switch it back on.

Used by the Cybersun stealth hardsuit helmet, which also carries the CV-53 helmet's night vision, plus a thermal pulse.
